onboardingWelcomeBody: Browse, manage, and transfer files between your phone and any PC on your network.
onboardingHowBody: Install the agent on your PC, then pair this phone by scanning its QR or approving the request on the PC. You're connected over Wi-Fi or Tailscale.
onboardingReadyBody: Pair your first PC to start exploring. Your files stay on your devices — nothing goes to the cloud.

giFirstRunNeedsApp: The computer needs the RFE app running.
giAddIntro: On the computer, open RFE and choose Pair a phone. Point this camera at the code it shows.
giNoneFound: No computers found on this Wi-Fi. Check that RFE is running on the computer and that both are on the same network.
giSearchFailed: Could not look on this Wi-Fi. Scan the code instead.
giWifiUnavailable: Looking on this Wi-Fi works on Android only. Scan the code instead.
giAddressHelp: Use this when the computer is not on your Wi-Fi. The computer then asks you to allow this phone.

confirmTrustAccountBody: This phone will ask this computer to sign it in. Trust it only if it is the computer you set up.
giAllowTitle: Allow this phone on your computer
giAllowBody: The computer now shows a request from this phone. Allow it only if it shows this number:
giDeclinedBody: Someone pressed Refuse on the computer. Ask again if that was a mistake.
giExpiredBody: The request ran out of time. Ask again, then press Allow on the computer.
giTooOldBody: Its RFE app is too old to ask for permission. Scan the code it shows, or update RFE on it.
giFailedBody: Check that RFE is running on it and that this phone is on the same network.
giScanBad: That is not an RFE code. Scan the code on the Pair a phone screen of the computer.
giScanIdentity: This is not the computer you added before. RFE stopped before sending anything.
giScanFailed: Could not add the computer. Try scanning again.
giCameraBlocked: Camera access is off. Turn it on in Settings, or add the computer another way.
giCameraNeeded: RFE needs the camera to read the code.
giIdentityBody1: This happens after RFE is reinstalled on it. It can also mean another computer is pretending to be it. RFE stopped before sending anything.
giIdentityBody2: If you reinstalled RFE yourself, add the computer again. Otherwise leave it until you have checked.
giAsleepBody: Could not reach this computer. RFE can wake it if another computer on the same network is on. It usually takes under a minute.
stateRefusedTitle: This computer removed this phone's access
stateRefusedBody: It still answers, but it no longer accepts this phone. Pair again to get access back.
giLostBody: Nothing is lost. RFE keeps trying and carries on by itself when it is back.
giUnknownTitle: RFE cannot tell if this is {name}
giUnknownBody1: This phone has no saved identity for this computer, so it cannot check that whatever answers is really {name}.
giUnknownBody2: Add the computer again while you are near it. Otherwise leave it until you have checked.
